meta.title: Beyond The Bounds
meta.description: She flaps her wings at last and embraces the skies of freedom.

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria—</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria—

spans.text: Persicaria—

units.rawText: As my shout fills the hall, I reach out to try and grab Persicaria's fading form, but I fall short. Just as I'm about to fall, however, a warm hand meets mine and hauls me up.
units.displayText: As my shout fills the hall, I reach out to try and grab Persicaria's fading form, but I fall short. Just as I'm about to fall, however, a warm hand meets mine and hauls me up.

spans.text: As my shout fills the hall, I reach out to try and grab Persicaria's fading form, but I fall short. Just as I'm about to fall, however, a warm hand meets mine and hauls me up.

units.rawText: In my blurred vision, I see a pink-haired girl with a pale face holding on tightly to my hand.
units.displayText: In my blurred vision, I see a pink-haired girl with a pale face holding on tightly to my hand.

spans.text: In my blurred vision, I see a pink-haired girl with a pale face holding on tightly to my hand.

units.rawText: I'm here, Professor.
units.displayText: I'm here, Professor.

spans.text: I'm here, Professor.

units.rawText: That word causes my reason and restraint to collapse. I promptly pull her into my arms.
units.displayText: That word causes my reason and restraint to collapse. I promptly pull her into my arms.

spans.text: That word causes my reason and restraint to collapse. I promptly pull her into my arms.

units.rawText: Time seems to stand still, and the clamor around us fades into the distance.
units.displayText: Time seems to stand still, and the clamor around us fades into the distance.

spans.text: Time seems to stand still, and the clamor around us fades into the distance.

units.rawText: As I feel the warmth in my arms fading away and watch the deep purple spreading from her fingers to envelop her entire body, the words I long to say get caught in my throat. Not a single one escapes.
units.displayText: As I feel the warmth in my arms fading away and watch the deep purple spreading from her fingers to envelop her entire body, the words I long to say get caught in my throat. Not a single one escapes.

spans.text: As I feel the warmth in my arms fading away and watch the deep purple spreading from her fingers to envelop her entire body, the words I long to say get caught in my throat. Not a single one escapes.

units.rawText: Persicaria lightly pats me on the back.
units.displayText: Persicaria lightly pats me on the back.

spans.text: Persicaria lightly pats me on the back.

units.rawText: It's alright, Professor... The authorizations won't be fully transferred for a while.
units.displayText: It's alright, Professor... The authorizations won't be fully transferred for a while.

spans.text: It's alright, Professor... The authorizations won't be fully transferred for a while.

units.rawText: Perhaps I might be able to accompany you on this final journey.
units.displayText: Perhaps I might be able to accompany you on this final journey.

spans.text: Perhaps I might be able to accompany you on this final journey.

units.rawText: After that, you must take care of yourself. Your Persicaria will pray for you forever...
units.displayText: After that, you must take care of yourself. Your Persicaria will pray for you forever...

spans.text: After that, you must take care of yourself. Your Persicaria will pray for you forever...

units.rawText: No, there's got to be a way to break this curse...
units.displayText: No, there's got to be a way to break this curse...

spans.text: No, there's got to be a way to break this curse...

units.rawText: Shhh—
units.displayText: Shhh—

spans.text: Shhh—

units.rawText: She presses her finger to my lips.
units.displayText: She presses her finger to my lips.

spans.text: She presses her finger to my lips.

units.rawText: I know this can't be hidden, but I don't want to distract the others right now.
units.displayText: I know this can't be hidden, but I don't want to distract the others right now.

spans.text: I know this can't be hidden, but I don't want to distract the others right now.

units.rawText: Our current priority is to hurry to the Reverse Tower and stop Eosphorus. Discussing the authorization transfer can wait until after the battle.
units.displayText: Our current priority is to hurry to the Reverse Tower and stop Eosphorus. Discussing the authorization transfer can wait until after the battle.

spans.text: Our current priority is to hurry to the Reverse Tower and stop Eosphorus. Discussing the authorization transfer can wait until after the battle.

units.rawText: But your body...
units.displayText: But your body...

spans.text: But your body...

units.rawText: The traces of Entropization are masked by her wounds from battle, but I can clearly see how much pain she must be in.
units.displayText: The traces of Entropization are masked by her wounds from battle, but I can clearly see how much pain she must be in.

spans.text: The traces of Entropization are masked by her wounds from battle, but I can clearly see how much pain she must be in.

units.rawText: It's alright, Professor...
units.displayText: It's alright, Professor...

spans.text: It's alright, Professor...

units.rawText: The truth is, I feel much better just being by your side.
units.displayText: The truth is, I feel much better just being by your side.

spans.text: The truth is, I feel much better just being by your side.

units.rawText: As she sees our friends approaching, Persicaria smiles at me before shaking her head, then pulls her coat tight around her to hide the Entropic veins creeping up her body.
units.displayText: As she sees our friends approaching, Persicaria smiles at me before shaking her head, then pulls her coat tight around her to hide the Entropic veins creeping up her body.

spans.text: As she sees our friends approaching, Persicaria smiles at me before shaking her head, then pulls her coat tight around her to hide the Entropic veins creeping up her body.

units.rawText: You guys are awake at last!
units.displayText: You guys are awake at last!

spans.text: You guys are awake at last!

units.rawText: Sol breathes a sigh of relief, then eyes Malkira warily, afraid she might attack again.
units.displayText: Sol breathes a sigh of relief, then eyes Malkira warily, afraid she might attack again.

spans.text: Sol breathes a sigh of relief, then eyes Malkira warily, afraid she might attack again.

units.rawText: You guys went silent all of a sudden. You scared the heck out of me.
units.displayText: You guys went silent all of a sudden. You scared the heck out of me.

spans.text: You guys went silent all of a sudden. You scared the heck out of me.

units.rawText: Still, since you're awake, it's time we made Malkira pay!
units.displayText: Still, since you're awake, it's time we made Malkira pay!

spans.text: Still, since you're awake, it's time we made Malkira pay!

units.rawText: Wait, Sol.
units.displayText: Wait, Sol.

spans.text: Wait, Sol.

units.rawText: She no longer poses a threat to us.
units.displayText: She no longer poses a threat to us.

spans.text: She no longer poses a threat to us.

units.rawText: Say what?! You mean we're going to stop fighting, just like that?
units.displayText: Say what?! You mean we're going to stop fighting, just like that?

spans.text: Say what?! You mean we're going to stop fighting, just like that?

units.rawText: There's a change in my neural cloud... The Entropic power inside me...
units.displayText: There's a change in my neural cloud... The Entropic power inside me...

spans.text: There's a change in my neural cloud... The Entropic power inside me...

units.rawText: The girl in black stares silently at her palm. She can feel her link to Malkira fading away, and the tremors in her core are growing more and more intense.
units.displayText: The girl in black stares silently at her palm. She can feel her link to Malkira fading away, and the tremors in her core are growing more and more intense.

spans.text: The girl in black stares silently at her palm. She can feel her link to Malkira fading away, and the tremors in her core are growing more and more intense.

units.rawText: Sol has no idea what is going on, and for a while, all she can do is scratch her head in bafflement.
units.displayText: Sol has no idea what is going on, and for a while, all she can do is scratch her head in bafflement.

spans.text: Sol has no idea what is going on, and for a while, all she can do is scratch her head in bafflement.

units.rawText: Wait, so we're just going to ignore everything she did to the Prof and everyone else and just let her go?
units.displayText: Wait, so we're just going to ignore everything she did to the Prof and everyone else and just let her go?

spans.text: Wait, so we're just going to ignore everything she did to the Prof and everyone else and just let her go?

units.rawText: We're not letting her go. Rather, killing her wouldn't solve anything.
units.displayText: We're not letting her go. Rather, killing her wouldn't solve anything.

spans.text: We're not letting her go. Rather, killing her wouldn't solve anything.

units.rawText: I clench my fist and glare at Malkira.
units.displayText: I clench my fist and glare at Malkira.

spans.text: I clench my fist and glare at Malkira.

units.rawText: The former queen has emerged from the neural cloud space and was the first to awake. Malkira doesn't seem to mind our hateful glances. Instead, she speaks in a casual tone.
units.displayText: The former queen has emerged from the neural cloud space and was the first to awake. Malkira doesn't seem to mind our hateful glances. Instead, she speaks in a casual tone.

spans.text: The former queen has emerged from the neural cloud space and was the first to awake. Malkira doesn't seem to mind our hateful glances. Instead, she speaks in a casual tone.

units.rawText: Well, the negotiations are over, so there shouldn't be any reason left for us to be glaring at each other, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Well, the negotiations are over, so there shouldn't be any reason left for us to be glaring at each other, {교수}.

spans.text: Well, the negotiations are over, so there shouldn't be any reason left for us to be glaring at each other,

units.rawText: Oh yes, you've already achieved your aim, after all.
units.displayText: Oh yes, you've already achieved your aim, after all.

spans.text: Oh yes, you've already achieved your aim, after all.

units.rawText: Now now, don't be so negative. It's a win-win situation.
units.displayText: Now now, don't be so negative. It's a win-win situation.

spans.text: Now now, don't be so negative. It's a win-win situation.

units.rawText: Hohoho, it must be difficult for outsiders to understand our little secret. However, I'm sure you understand better than everyone else that everything in this world is fair, and that every choice has its own hidden price.
units.displayText: Hohoho, it must be difficult for outsiders to understand our little secret. However, I'm sure you understand better than everyone else that everything in this world is fair, and that every choice has its own hidden price.

spans.text: Hohoho, it must be difficult for outsiders to understand our little secret. However, I'm sure you understand better than everyone else that everything in this world is fair, and that every choice has its own hidden price.

units.rawText: You've lost one of your beloved followers and, in turn, gained the power to oppose Eosphorus. A worthwhile trade, don't you think?
units.displayText: You've lost one of your beloved followers and, in turn, gained the power to oppose Eosphorus. A worthwhile trade, don't you think?

spans.text: You've lost one of your beloved followers and, in turn, gained the power to oppose Eosphorus. A worthwhile trade, don't you think?

units.rawText: Plus, she was eager to pay the price on your behalf. You should be happily accepting her goodwill.
units.displayText: Plus, she was eager to pay the price on your behalf. You should be happily accepting her goodwill.

spans.text: Plus, she was eager to pay the price on your behalf. You should be happily accepting her goodwill.

units.rawText: You're just using the kindness of others to cover up your own despicable deeds. What about you? What price did you pay in all this?
units.displayText: You're just using the kindness of others to cover up your own despicable deeds. What about you? What price did you pay in all this?

spans.text: You're just using the kindness of others to cover up your own despicable deeds. What about you? What price did you pay in all this?

units.rawText: Me, hm...
units.displayText: Me, hm...

spans.text: Me, hm...

units.rawText: Hoho, oh yes. What kind of price did I pay?
units.displayText: Hoho, oh yes. What kind of price did I pay?

spans.text: Hoho, oh yes. What kind of price
did
I pay?

units.rawText: She looks down, and the expression on her face is shrouded in shadow.
units.displayText: She looks down, and the expression on her face is shrouded in shadow.

spans.text: She looks down, and the expression on her face is shrouded in shadow.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A blazing sword hovers over Malkira's chest, pointed directly at her vitals. The blade reflects the wrath on Sol's face.
units.displayText: A blazing sword hovers over Malkira's chest, pointed directly at her vitals. The blade reflects the wrath on Sol's face.

spans.text: A blazing sword hovers over Malkira's chest, pointed directly at her vitals. The blade reflects the wrath on Sol's face.

units.rawText: Even if you've settled things between you and the Prof, I still want an answer.
units.displayText: Even if you've settled things between you and the Prof, I still want an answer.

spans.text: Even if you've settled things between you and the Prof,
I
still want an answer.

units.rawText: Huh, I forgot you two were still around...
units.displayText: Huh, I forgot you two were still around...

spans.text: Huh, I forgot you two were still around...

units.rawText: Entropic Sol pushes down the sword and walks between Sol and Malkira.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol pushes down the sword and walks between Sol and Malkira.

spans.text: Entropic Sol pushes down the sword and walks between Sol and Malkira.

units.rawText: Lady Malkira, I have followed you faithfully thus far. But... what exactly were you hiding from me?
units.displayText: Lady Malkira, I have followed you faithfully thus far. But... what exactly were you hiding from me?

spans.text: Lady Malkira, I have followed you faithfully thus far. But... what exactly were you hiding from me?

units.rawText: Please tell me. I want to know who I am, where I came from, and why I am here.
units.displayText: Please tell me. I want to know who I am, where I came from, and why I am here.

spans.text: Please tell me. I want to know who I am, where I came from, and why I am here.

units.rawText: Oh, my child... the answer was obvious from the beginning. I called you "Sol" all this time because you are "Sol".
units.displayText: Oh, my child... the answer was obvious from the beginning. I called you "Sol" all this time because you are "Sol".

spans.text: Oh, my child... the answer was obvious from the beginning. I called you "Sol" all this time because you
are
"Sol".

units.rawText: After that battle with Eosphorus' clone, Ptolemaea's servants recovered part of Sol's core from the battlefield.
units.displayText: After that battle with Eosphorus' clone, Ptolemaea's servants recovered part of Sol's core from the battlefield.

spans.text: After that battle with Eosphorus' clone, Ptolemaea's servants recovered part of Sol's core from the battlefield.

units.rawText: It was still trembling slightly, but it had long since ceased to function. So I linked the fragment to my main body, infused it with Entropic power, and made you.
units.displayText: It was still trembling slightly, but it had long since ceased to function. So I linked the fragment to my main body, infused it with Entropic power, and made you.

spans.text: It was still trembling slightly, but it had long since ceased to function. So I linked the fragment to my main body, infused it with Entropic power, and made you.

units.rawText: So my body contains Entropic and Agent parts...
units.displayText: So my body contains Entropic and Agent parts...

spans.text: So my body contains Entropic and Agent parts...

units.rawText: Though she had a faint idea of what was going on, it's still hard for Entropic Sol to hide her shock after hearing the truth laid out this plainly.
units.displayText: Though she had a faint idea of what was going on, it's still hard for Entropic Sol to hide her shock after hearing the truth laid out this plainly.

spans.text: Though she had a faint idea of what was going on, it's still hard for Entropic Sol to hide her shock after hearing the truth laid out this plainly.

units.rawText: The girl in black inhales deeply, tries to calm herself, and continues asking.
units.displayText: The girl in black inhales deeply, tries to calm herself, and continues asking.

spans.text: The girl in black inhales deeply, tries to calm herself, and continues asking.

units.rawText: So why did you lie to me and say it was redundant data, that my past didn't exist?
units.displayText: So why did you lie to me and say it was redundant data, that my past didn't exist?

spans.text: So why did you lie to me and say it was redundant data, that my past didn't exist?

units.rawText: You inherited the power of an electronic virus, yet your core was that of a Doll. I knew your heart would be conflicted, but the pressing circumstances would not permit you the luxury of remaining caught in a tug-of-war between those two sides of you.
units.displayText: You inherited the power of an electronic virus, yet your core was that of a Doll. I knew your heart would be conflicted, but the pressing circumstances would not permit you the luxury of remaining caught in a tug-of-war between those two sides of you.

spans.text: You inherited the power of an electronic virus, yet your core was that of a Doll. I knew your heart would be conflicted, but the pressing circumstances would not permit you the luxury of remaining caught in a tug-of-war between those two sides of you.

units.rawText: And so, when you awoke, I made that decision for you; to abandon your past and live as an Entropic in Tartarus.
units.displayText: And so, when you awoke, I made that decision for you; to abandon your past and live as an Entropic in Tartarus.

spans.text: And so, when you awoke, I made that decision for you; to abandon your past and live as an Entropic in Tartarus.

units.rawText: It was the most logical and easiest choice to make. You wouldn't have to worry about your past bonds, and you would be able to freely Entropize and destroy everything.
units.displayText: It was the most logical and easiest choice to make. You wouldn't have to worry about your past bonds, and you would be able to freely Entropize and destroy everything.

spans.text: It was the most logical and easiest choice to make. You wouldn't have to worry about your past bonds, and you would be able to freely Entropize and destroy everything.

units.rawText: You wouldn't need to question yourself for being an Entropic or worry about how to control your power. You wouldn't fit in with other agents and you'd have to kneel to them in order to coexist anyway.
units.displayText: You wouldn't need to question yourself for being an Entropic or worry about how to control your power. You wouldn't fit in with other agents and you'd have to kneel to them in order to coexist anyway.

spans.text: You wouldn't need to question yourself for being an Entropic or worry about how to control your power. You wouldn't fit in with other agents and you'd have to kneel to them in order to coexist anyway.

units.rawText: Wouldn't you be happy to abandon a fake and hollow life like that, Sol?
units.displayText: Wouldn't you be happy to abandon a fake and hollow life like that, Sol?

spans.text: Wouldn't you be happy to abandon a fake and hollow life like that, Sol?

units.rawText: You're not the one who gets to decide whether she's happy or not, Malkira.
units.displayText: You're not the one who gets to decide whether she's happy or not, Malkira.

spans.text: You're not the one who gets to decide whether she's happy or not, Malkira.

units.rawText: Before she can answer, a familiar voice speaks from behind her.
units.displayText: Before she can answer, a familiar voice speaks from behind her.

spans.text: Before she can answer, a familiar voice speaks from behind her.

units.rawText: She needed to know the truth and then make her choice. Whether to face it or run would then come down to her will.
units.displayText: She needed to know the truth and then make her choice. Whether to face it or run would then come down to her will.

spans.text: She needed to know the truth and then make her choice. Whether to face it or run would then come down to her will.

units.rawText: It should not have been the result of violating her own nature because of your fake goodwill. By covering up the truth and lying about her circumstances, all you did was reduce her into a convenient tool. So don't go making pretty excuses for your selfishness.
units.displayText: It should not have been the result of violating her own nature because of your fake goodwill. By covering up the truth and lying about her circumstances, all you did was reduce her into a convenient tool. So don't go making pretty excuses for your selfishness.

spans.text: It should not have been the result of violating her own nature because of your fake goodwill. By covering up the truth and lying about her circumstances, all you did was reduce her into a convenient tool. So don't go making pretty excuses for your selfishness.

units.rawText: Yeah, that's right! If she'd chosen to fight us, then we'd have fought her.
units.displayText: Yeah, that's right! If she'd chosen to fight us, then we'd have fought her.

spans.text: Yeah, that's right! If she'd chosen to fight us, then we'd have fought her.

units.rawText: And if she'd chosen to be our friend, we'd have accepted her too and waited for her to come back with us!
units.displayText: And if she'd chosen to be our friend, we'd have accepted her too and waited for her to come back with us!

spans.text: And if she'd chosen to be our friend, we'd have accepted her too and waited for her to come back with us!

units.rawText: Entropic Sol looks back.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol looks back.

spans.text: Entropic Sol looks back.

units.rawText: Persicaria and the girl in orange are looking expectantly at her, while the Professor's gaze is accepting and understanding.
units.displayText: Persicaria and the girl in orange are looking expectantly at her, while the Professor's gaze is accepting and understanding.

spans.text: Persicaria and the girl in orange are looking expectantly at her, while the Professor's gaze is accepting and understanding.

units.rawText: And now, you know everything. You have a chance to choose anew. Whether you choose to return with us or not, we will respect your decision.
units.displayText: And now, you know everything. You have a chance to choose anew. Whether you choose to return with us or not, we will respect your decision.

spans.text: And now, you know everything. You have a chance to choose anew. Whether you choose to return with us or not, we will respect your decision.

units.rawText: Can... Can I become a new "Sol"?
units.displayText: Can... Can I become a new "Sol"?

spans.text: Can... Can I become a new "Sol"?

units.rawText: Sure, you can become Sol. You can choose not to become Sol. You can become anyone you want to be.
units.displayText: Sure, you can become Sol. You can choose not to become Sol. You can become anyone you want to be.

spans.text: Sure, you can become Sol. You can choose not to become Sol. You can become anyone you want to be.

units.rawText: The moon is different from the sun, but it can still shine at night and light the way for others, and it should be praised for that too.
units.displayText: The moon is different from the sun, but it can still shine at night and light the way for others, and it should be praised for that too.

spans.text: The moon is different from the sun, but it can still shine at night and light the way for others, and it should be praised for that too.

units.rawText: You mean, you won't reject me because I'm an Entropic?
units.displayText: You mean, you won't reject me because I'm an Entropic?

spans.text: You mean, you won't reject me because I'm an Entropic?

units.rawText: Everyone shakes their head.
units.displayText: Everyone shakes their head.

spans.text: Everyone shakes their head.

units.rawText: The girl in black knows what they're expecting. They want to continue their relationship with her, but they also want to give her the right to decide what to do with herself.
units.displayText: The girl in black knows what they're expecting. They want to continue their relationship with her, but they also want to give her the right to decide what to do with herself.

spans.text: The girl in black knows what they're expecting. They want to continue their relationship with her, but they also want to give her the right to decide what to do with herself.

units.rawText: Entropic Sol recalls her dream from before. In that dream, countless hands were holding onto her. She had thought it was the people and things in her dream that were binding her.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol recalls her dream from before. In that dream, countless hands were holding onto her. She had thought it was the people and things in her dream that were binding her.

spans.text: Entropic Sol recalls her dream from before. In that dream, countless hands were holding onto her. She had thought it was the people and things in her dream that were binding her.

units.rawText: But in truth, she was the one who had bound herself.
units.displayText: But in truth, she was the one who had bound herself.

spans.text: But in truth, she was the one who had bound herself.

units.rawText: I... There are many things I haven't figured out yet, about myself, about agents, about Entropics... So maybe I can't decide that quickly.
units.displayText: I... There are many things I haven't figured out yet, about myself, about agents, about Entropics... So maybe I can't decide that quickly.

spans.text: I... There are many things I haven't figured out yet, about myself, about agents, about Entropics... So maybe I can't decide that quickly.

units.rawText: But I'd like to try and make sense of the stuff I've been running from.
units.displayText: But I'd like to try and make sense of the stuff I've been running from.

spans.text: But I'd like to try and make sense of the stuff I've been running from.

units.rawText: Sol, I don't mind supplying you with operands, or even allocating you part of my neural cloud so you don't disappear. And Professor, I'm willing to lend you my strength and fight for you.
units.displayText: Sol, I don't mind supplying you with operands, or even allocating you part of my neural cloud so you don't disappear. And Professor, I'm willing to lend you my strength and fight for you.

spans.text: Sol, I don't mind supplying you with operands, or even allocating you part of my neural cloud so you don't disappear. And Professor, I'm willing to lend you my strength and fight for you.

units.rawText: ...In turn, will you help me make sense of my past and figure myself out?
units.displayText: ...In turn, will you help me make sense of my past and figure myself out?

spans.text: ...In turn, will you help me make sense of my past and figure myself out?

units.rawText: Entropic Sol eyes them nervously. They were friends once, and also enemies, but now...
units.displayText: Entropic Sol eyes them nervously. They were friends once, and also enemies, but now...

spans.text: Entropic Sol eyes them nervously. They were friends once, and also enemies, but now...

units.rawText: The person in white smiles.
units.displayText: The person in white smiles.

spans.text: The person in white smiles.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Of course.</color>
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: Ahhhhh, why are you making stuff so complicated?!
units.displayText: Ahhhhh, why are you making stuff so complicated?!

spans.text: Ahhhhh, why are you making stuff so complicated?!

units.rawText: Sol puts an arm around her black-clad clone and pulls her into her arms for a vigorous head pat.
units.displayText: Sol puts an arm around her black-clad clone and pulls her into her arms for a vigorous head pat.

spans.text: Sol puts an arm around her black-clad clone and pulls her into her arms for a vigorous head pat.

units.rawText: How could we possibly say no? I told you before, right?
units.displayText: How could we possibly say no? I told you before, right?

spans.text: How could we possibly say no? I told you before, right?

units.rawText: Perhaps it's because she has the same core as her, or maybe it's because they have the same memories, but when she's close to Sol, countless images run through her mind and her past becomes clearer in her head.
units.displayText: Perhaps it's because she has the same core as her, or maybe it's because they have the same memories, but when she's close to Sol, countless images run through her mind and her past becomes clearer in her head.

spans.text: Perhaps it's because she has the same core as her, or maybe it's because they have the same memories, but when she's close to Sol, countless images run through her mind and her past becomes clearer in her head.

units.rawText: Never mind that she hasn't been to the places in those memories, or experienced the happy life in them.
units.displayText: Never mind that she hasn't been to the places in those memories, or experienced the happy life in them.

spans.text: Never mind that she hasn't been to the places in those memories, or experienced the happy life in them.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, want to go visit the places in your memories?
units.displayText: Oh yeah, want to go visit the places in your memories?

spans.text: Oh yeah, want to go visit the places in your memories?

units.rawText: Just as Sol says this, a word appears in Entropic Sol's mind.
units.displayText: Just as Sol says this, a word appears in Entropic Sol's mind.

spans.text: Just as Sol says this, a word appears in Entropic Sol's mind.

units.rawText: You mean... to the Oasis?
